text:
mia: Hey team — FRA edge pool 3 saw a thermal spike overnight, 4 H100s flagged DOA-ish during intake. Depot is asking if we want RMA overnight or local swap.

sam: Ugh. Any serials? ETA to depot?

jordan: Serial list posted to the ticket: S/N H100-7721, H100-7722, H100-7723, H100-7724. Depot photo evidence attached to the ticket. They say 48h triage window.

vendor-liaison: We can do an overnight RMA but need AWB to be prebooked by EOD. Also need HS code confirmation for customs — FRA has been strict.

mia: @vendor-liaison please advise shipping option: air overnight vs same-day courier. What's delta in cost and lead time? We need minimal downtime for the edge pools.

vendor-liaison: Air overnight: ~€1,600 per unit door-to-door including uplift, customs pre-clear. Same-day courier (road) not guaranteed overnight, likely 24-36h, ~€700 per unit. Air requires depot to accept by 10:30 CET for next-day delivery.

lenka: If we do air, can we sleeve the units back into the cluster with temporary throttling? Prefer not to fully decommission.

jordan: We had prefix/KV cache warmups on those nodes; swap will cause some hit but can be staggered. I'd push for air on one unit at a time.

sam: Are there any warranty credits? Last quarter we negotiated expedited RMA credits for thermal failures.

vendor-liaison: Quick check — warranty covers DOA and thermal defects within the SLA, but expedited air uplift credit is conditional. I can push for 50% uplift credit if we commit to bulk returns (>=8 units) within the quarter. For 4 units, looks like partial credit only.

mia: Given capacity constraints in FRA region this week, losing 4 H100s (even briefly) will reduce pool throughput by ~18%. We should prioritize the most impacted customers. Jordan, can you list the top 3 routes affected?

jordan: Routes: gen-infer-01, batch-encode-uae, realtime-emb-ams. Gen-infer-01 has the highest latency sensitivity.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-3479 (FRA edge pool 3 thermal event) — auto-notify oncall.

lenka: Operational ask: if vendor needs photos and serials in a single manifest, send them this format:

```
AWB: <leave blank until booked>
Model: H100
Serials:
- H100-7721 (photo attached)
- H100-7722 (photo attached)
- H100-7723 (photo attached)
- H100-7724 (photo attached)
Depot SLA requested: 48h triage
Preferred action: Overnight air for 7721 then stagger rest
```

vendor-liaison: Copy — I'll prebook one AWB for 7721 tonight and hold quotes for the remaining three. Need sender contact (ops on-site) to drop units at FRA depot by 10:00 tomorrow.

mia: On-site ops: @sam can you confirm drop window and whether we have customs broker pre-approval?

sam: I can be at the depot tomorrow 07:30 CET. Customs broker: we have pre-approval under our K2026 account but need HS code.

vendor-liaison: HS code for GPUs is 8471.80.00 in our shipping docs. I'll include that in the manifest.

jordan: Also flag that these are 'Customer owned, return for replacement' in the AWB to speed handling.

lenka: One more ask — failure mode: looks like thermal pad delamination in photos. Can we capture a short postmortem to feed RMA claim? Minimal bullet points in the ticket are fine.

mia: I'll draft a 3-bullet RCA and attach to the manifest. If vendor will agree to 50% uplift credit for 2 of the 4 units if we queue replacements within 30 days, take it. Negotiate that, @vendor-liaison.

vendor-liaison: Roger — I'll push for that and update by 18:00 CET. Booking AWB for 7721 now.

sam: Thx. Keep ops-bot in the loop for any schedule changes.

ops-bot: AWB booked: 125-FR-7721 (provisional) — vendor to confirm final AWB by 18:00 CET.

mia: Great. Let's reconvene here once vendor confirms credits and final AWBs. :thumbsup:
